Sample info - metadata (Done in local R studio)
```{r}
#metadata 
# Read raw GEO lines
lines <- readLines("~/Documents/Masters Bioinformatics BU/Courses/Biological Data Science in R/Final Project/GSE64810_series_matrix.txt")

# Keep only sample metadata lines
sample_lines <- grep("^!Sample_", lines, value = TRUE)

# Split each line on tabs
split_lines <- strsplit(sample_lines, "\t")

# Extract field names
field_names <- gsub("^!Sample_", "", sapply(split_lines, `[`, 1))

# Make duplicate names unique
field_names <- make.unique(field_names)

# Extract values
values <- lapply(split_lines, function(x) x[-1])

# Remove quotation marks
values <- lapply(values, function(x) gsub("\"", "", x))

# Create dataframe
metadata <- as.data.frame(t(do.call(rbind, values)),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Assign unique column names
colnames(metadata) <- field_names
colnames(metadata)

unique(metadata$characteristics_ch1.1)

unique(metadata$characteristics_ch1.2)

head(metadata[, grep("characteristics", colnames(metadata))])

metadata_clean <- data.frame(
  sample_name = metadata$title,
  geo_accession = metadata$geo_accession,
  tissue = metadata$characteristics_ch1,
  diagnosis = metadata$characteristics_ch1.1,
  pmi = metadata$characteristics_ch1.2,
  age = metadata$characteristics_ch1.3,
  rin = metadata$characteristics_ch1.4,
  reads = metadata$characteristics_ch1.5,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

metadata_clean$tissue <- sub("tissue: ", "", metadata_clean$tissue)

metadata_clean$diagnosis <- sub("diagnosis: ", "", metadata_clean$diagnosis)

metadata_clean$pmi <- sub("pmi: ", "", metadata_clean$pmi)

metadata_clean$age <- sub("age of death: ", "", metadata_clean$age)

metadata_clean$rin <- sub("rin: ", "", metadata_clean$rin)

metadata_clean$reads <- sub("mrna-seq reads: ", "", metadata_clean$reads)


metadata_clean$pmi <- as.numeric(metadata_clean$pmi)

metadata_clean$age <- as.numeric(metadata_clean$age)

metadata_clean$rin <- as.numeric(metadata_clean$rin)

metadata_clean$reads <- as.numeric(metadata_clean$reads)

head(metadata_clean)

str(metadata_clean)

write.csv(
  metadata_clean,
  "~/Documents/Masters Bioinformatics BU/Courses/Biological Data Science in R/Final Project/metadata.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)
```



DESeq2 (read in on local R studio, then uploaded and finished cleaning up on scc)
```{r}
de_results <- read.csv("~/Documents/Masters Bioinformatics BU/Courses/Biological Data Science in R/Final Project/de_results.csv", header = TRUE)
colnames(de_results)[colnames(de_results) == "X"] <- "gene_id"
de_results$X.1 <- NULL
colnames(de_results)
head(de_results$gene_id)

strip_data <- de_results$gene_id <- sub("\\..*", "", de_results$gene_id)
```


FGSEA (fully carried out on scc)
```{r}
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)


# 1. Remove rows without gene symbols first
de_results_clean <- de_results[!is.na(de_results$symbol), ]

# 2. Remove duplicate gene symbols (keep highest stat)
de_results_clean <- de_results_clean[
  order(de_results_clean$stat, decreasing = TRUE),
]

de_results_clean <- de_results_clean[
  !duplicated(de_results_clean$symbol),
]

# 3. Build ranked vector
ranks <- de_results_clean$stat
names(ranks) <- de_results_clean$symbol

# 4. Remove any leftover NA names (safety step)
ranks <- ranks[!is.na(names(ranks))]

# 5. Sort once (FINAL required step)
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

# sanity check 
head(ranks)
length(ranks)
sum(is.na(ranks))

msig <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
pathways <- split(msig$gene_symbol, msig$gs_name)

#run FGSEA
fgseaRes <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = pathways,
                  stats = ranks)

```

Writing fgsea file to csv to download 
```{r}
# Copy original FGSEA results
fgseaRes_df <- fgseaRes

# Convert leadingEdge list column into text
fgseaRes_df$leadingEdge <- sapply(
  fgseaRes_df$leadingEdge,
  paste,
  collapse = ";"
)

# Write CSV
write.csv(
  fgseaRes_df,
  file = "gsea_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

```
